name: B1 Ventures
problem: Investor information and account history needed a private, usable home.
built: A branded website and private investor portal with per-user dashboards, document access, portfolio information, and payment history.
context: B1 Ventures works with investors and businesses. The public website and private account experience have different jobs: explain the offer and give each investor access to their own information.
challenge: Organize sensitive, investor-specific information without making the public site or account area difficult to use.
solution: Built the public-facing presence and a custom WordPress-based investor experience, separating general content from signed-in, per-user views.
results: Delivered a private investor experience with per-user dashboards, documents, portfolio information, and payment history.

name: Kaizen Firm
problem: A recruitment business needed a site that could explain its services across languages and audiences.
built: A multilingual recruitment website with job information, candidate paths, and enterprise service pages.
context: Kaizen Firm serves recruitment and enterprise-service audiences in MENA.
challenge: Make services and candidate information navigable in English, Arabic, and French.
solution: Structured the site around distinct audience paths and localized content using WordPress and Polylang.
results: Delivered a live recruitment site with English, Arabic, and French content paths.

name: Umbrella500

context: Umbrella500 presents a startup and growth-focused offer to potential partners.
challenge: Express the studio's positioning while keeping the experience readable and responsive.
solution: Developed the interface with custom front-end styling and restrained motion around the content hierarchy.
results: Delivered a responsive, redesigned web presence for the studio.
